description: This file contains multiple Orleans grain implementations related to persistence, including generic grains, error simulation grains, storage provider grains, reentrant grains, state serialization, and auxiliary classes for testing persistence behaviors in a Orleans-based project.

classes.name: TestRuntimeEnvironmentUtility
classes.description: Utility class for capturing runtime environment information for testing purposes.

classes.name: PersistenceGenericGrainState
classes.description: A serializable generic class representing the persistence state with multiple fields including a sorted dictionary.

classes.name: PersistenceTestGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain implementing persistence behavior with basic CRUD and state verification methods.

classes.name: PersistenceTestGenericGrain
classes.description: A generic version of PersistenceTestGrain, extending its functionality for generic state types.

classes.name: PersistenceProviderErrorGrain
classes.description: A grain simulating error scenarios during persistence operations using a specific storage provider.

classes.name: PersistenceUserHandledErrorGrain
classes.description: A grain that handles errors during persistence operations with user-defined logic and logging.

classes.name: PersistenceProviderErrorProxyGrain
classes.description: A proxy grain to delegate persistence method calls to other grains, used for testing.

classes.name: PersistenceErrorGrain
classes.description: A grain that intentionally throws errors during persistence operations to test error handling.

classes.name: BadProviderTestGrain
classes.description: A grain referencing a non-existent or misconfigured storage provider to test failure modes.

classes.name: PersistenceNoStateTestGrain
classes.description: A grain with no persistence state, used for testing grains without persistent state.

classes.name: ServiceIdGrain
classes.description: A grain that provides the service ID from ClusterOptions, demonstrating dependency injection.

classes.name: GrainStorageTestGrain
classes.description: A grain using a custom storage provider with methods to read, write, and delete state, as well as retrieve its internal storage.

classes.name: GrainStorageGenericGrain
classes.description: A generic grain for storage testing with similar capabilities as GrainStorageTestGrain.

classes.name: GrainStorageTestGrainExtendedKey
classes.description: A storage grain that supports extended keys for storing state with custom key handling.

classes.name: MemoryStorageTestGrain
classes.description: A grain testing in-memory storage and serialization, including nested state classes.

classes.name: UserGrain
classes.description: An example grain implementing user profile features with state management and relationships.

classes.name: StateForIReentrentGrain
classes.description: State data class for a reentrant grain, supporting dictionaries and multiple fields.

classes.name: ReentrentGrainWithState
classes.description: A reentrant grain that performs complex, serialized state updates with environment verification.

classes.name: NonReentrantStressGrainWithoutState
classes.description: A stress test grain for non-reentrant scenarios, verifying single-threaded execution for asynchronous code.

classes.name: InternalGrainStateData
classes.description: Simple serializable class representing internal grain state.

classes.name: InternalGrainWithState
classes.description: A grain with internal state management for test purposes.

classes.name: StateInheritanceTestGrainData
classes.description: A serializable class demonstrating state inheritance and custom field attributes.

classes.name: StateInheritanceTestGrain
classes.description: A grain testing state inheritance and read/write operations.

classes.name: SurrogateStateForTypeWithoutPublicConstructorGrain
classes.description: A grain handling serialization surrogate for a type without a public constructor.

classes.name: ExternalTypeWithoutPublicConstructor
classes.description: A type with private constructor and static create method, used to test surrogate serialization.

classes.name: ExternalTypeWithoutPublicConstructorSurrogate
classes.description: Serializer surrogate for ExternalTypeWithoutPublicConstructor.

classes.name: ExternalTypeWithoutPublicConstructorSurrogateConverter
classes.description: Converter implementation for transforming between the type and its surrogate.

classes.name: RecordTypeWithoutPublicParameterlessConstructorGrain
classes.description: A grain managing a record type that lacks a public parameterless constructor, with surrogate serialization.

classes.name: RecordTypeWithoutPublicParameterlessConstructor
classes.description: A record type with a private constructor and a singleton property, used for surrogate serialization testing.
